summary_en: 76 ordinary shares to be cancelled effective 29 July 2026, representing 0.0% of shares outstanding. Post-cancellation issued share count: 28,305,924. Cancellation conditioned on approval of stock split (effective 30 July 2026) at extraordinary general meeting on 9 July 2026. Treasury holdings as of 29 May 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: The Global Ltd. announced on 10 June 2026 that its board of directors, acting by written resolution under the Companies Act and the company's articles, resolved to cancel 76 ordinary shares held in treasury. The cancellation is scheduled for 29 July 2026 and is conditioned upon shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting on 9 July 2026 of a concurrent stock split (effective 30 July 2026). The 76 shares represent the entirety of treasury holdings as of 29 May 2026 and constitute 0.0% of shares outstanding. Post-cancellation, issued share count will be 28,305,924 shares.
